## Summary
This capture is a **source/author page**, not a single article — the goal is to register *who to read* on inflation, not one argument.

- **Who:** Michael Ashton, long-standing inflation-markets specialist writing as the "Inflation Guy"; *E-piphany* is his blog. Focus visible from the page itself: **inflation measurement and CPI methodology**, **Fed policy commentary**, and **TIPS-adjacent macro** — the intersection this vault had no node for until now.
- **Recurring artifact:** the monthly **"Inflation Guy's CPI Summary"** series — May, June, and July 2026 editions visible on the author page, published ~week after month-end CPI release. This is the cadence worth knowing: a monthly, methodology-aware digest of each CPI print.
